_comment: Tech-watch settings. You edit this file; scouts can read it but never write it. Your personal limits (money, platforms, privacy, what never to propose) go in my/techwatch.md instead.

daily._comment: Opus, not Sonnet: on 2026-11-10 a Sonnet daily scout saw a new model generation launch and filed nothing, without reading the launch post.

check._comment: Reviews and improves each prepared change before it's tested. Remove this block to turn checks off.

cadence._comment: Which scans run is set in my/techwatch.md ("Scans: daily and weekly" or "weekly only"). This sets how often the weekly scan comes round.

docs_sync._comment: The weekly docs sync (scripts/docs_sync.py); README.md, 'Keeping the docs in step', explains each setting. Your own choices go in my/docs_sync.json (same keys), which overrides these. enabled: off by default, since it edits tracked files and would clash with updates; turn it on if you maintain your own fork. automatic: which kinds of edit are made without asking, if each changes at most max_words_per_change words: agents, skills, docs (README and the other docs); [] makes every edit wait. CLAUDE.md always waits. ask_in_sessions: false stops sessions from asking about waiting edits (then: python3 scripts/docs_sync.py show).

sources.why: Model launches, policy and program announcements
Agent/scaffolding guidance from the people who build the harness
A new docs page usually means a new Claude Code capability
High-signal independent coverage of new LLM tools across all vendors
New open-weight models that can run on a personal computer
Welfare-evaluation methods and tools that the workspace could adopt
